From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Finalizing terms & kickoff for Redwood integration — internal notes

Internal only — forwarding Alex's signed contract and my reply. High priority items and recommended owner/risks below. Do not include Lumen recipients in follow-up internal discussion.

Quoted message from Alex attached.

Key context / ask:
- Volume: ~35M tokens/month at launch (ramping to 60M q2). They are latency-sensitive (sub-150ms p99 target for short prompts) and will use both chat and embeddings.
- Data residency: US-central; PHI with SOC2 requirements and 90d audit visibility. Expect security questionnaire follow-up.
- Procurement: wants kickoff mid-Nov; they prefer afternoons PT.

Recommended immediate owners:
- Customer Success (primary): Marissa Cole — overall onboarding, success metrics, training, acceptance criteria, renewal trigger (45 days before term end).
- Technical PM (implementation): Tessa Morgan — run the implementation plan, integration points, EHR endpoint coordination, and cutover runbook.
- Solutions Engineer: Soojin Lee — architecture review, latency tuning, quantization/throughput tradeoffs.
- Sales escalation / exec sponsor: me (David) — drop-in for any procurement/contract issues.

Risks / open questions:
1) Dedicated capacity cost vs hosted burst: finance will need to accept recommended reserved pool; estimate an incremental commitment.
2) EHR integration: their endpoint team prefers certificate-based mTLS — ops will need cert exchange window.
3) Training cadence: they requested both site-admin and end-user training; plan for two 90-min workshops + recorded sessions.
4) Audit logs: determine exact schema they need (token-level vs summary) — Security and Compliance to weigh in.

Suggested timeline (compressed):
- Day 0 (Kickoff): align owners, acceptance criteria, timeline, and SSO/credentials collection.
- Week 1: Tech intake, architecture review, dedicated pool sizing decision, test creds issued.
- Weeks 2–4: Integration iterations, validation with synthetic data, performance baseline.
- Week 5: User training, UAT window opens.
- Week 6: Cutover & acceptance.

Attachments: executed contract + SOW draft. I'll coordinate legal for audit log SLA verbiage if they push.

Action for you both before EOD: review SOW milestones and reply with staffing (SE backup + oncall owner) and whether you prefer Nov 16 2pm PT or Nov 17 3pm PT for customer kickoff.

Thanks — david

[Forwarded attachments: Lumen_Tx_Executed_Contract.pdf, RW-SOW-draft-v1.docx]

David / Tessa — thanks for the context, this looks straightforward but a few flags:

1) Dedicated capacity: Ops can size a small dedicated pool to meet p99 latency targets; I'll request a cost estimate from Finance this morning. If procurement pushes back, we'll propose a hybrid approach (reserved pool + burst on hosted).

2) EHR mTLS: SE will need certs and a test endpoint. Soojin, can you confirm available slots for a 60-min architecture call next Tuesday (Nov 9) so we can pre-align before kickoff?

3) SOW milestones — suggest we tighten acceptance: require two production-like UAT scenarios with token sample sizes and a performance SLA check (p99 under 200ms). I've annotated RW-SOW-draft-v1.docx with changes and attached a kickoff agenda draft.

4) Staffing: Primary SE Soojin Lee, Secondary SE: Tessa will act as technical PM but we should nominate a bench SE in case of overlap (I propose Mina Haddad as backup; will confirm).

Preferred kickoff slot: Nov 16, 2:00pm PT works for me. I'll send a pro forma calendar invite to Alex + their team once we lock it.
